All the enemies are also given [[Boss]] if they do not have it. }} == Description == The '''Golden Mystery''' is a joke enemy that can only be spawned by the game's developers. It acts like a mystery enemy, spawning the [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Deathwalker]], [[Conserver]], [[Corrupted Conserver (Nil Zone)|Corrupted Conserver]], [[Nuclear Monster]], [[Kronus]], [[Null Commander]], [[Frost Spirit]], [[Producer]], [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]], [[Titus]], [[Corrupted Titus]], [[Null Guardian]], [[Brute]], [[Patient Zero]], [[Corrupted Haz3mn]], [[Fallen King]], [[Wox the Fox]], [[Nerd Ducky]], [[Ducky D00M III]], [[Molten Warlord]], [[Executioner (Pizza Party)|Executioner]], [[Jack-o-Bot]], [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] and [[Gunslinger]] upon death. All the enemies are also given [[Boss]] if they do not have it. ==Logbook Description== "''GOLDENNNNN MYSTERYYYY''" == Appearance == The '''Golden Mystery''' is similar to the [[Mega Frost Mystery]] in appearance, just tinted yellow unlike its icy counterpart. ==Trivia== *As the [[Jack-o-Bot]] enemy has the dialogue for it appearing be attached to it and not the actual waves, it being summoned through this enemy will cause it to play, though with a broken animation for the [[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]]. *Due to it at one point summoning every modern enemy, it would in theory be able to summon in unused modern enemies left in the game, like the unused Scam Bot enemy from the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]] or Decoy2 from the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. == Update History == *'''7 August 2026''' - [[v2.5.0]] **'''Golden Mystery''' added. *'''14 August 2026''' - [[v2.6.0]] **No longer summons every modern enemy in alphabetical order, now summons a few specific bosses, which includes the [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Deathwalker]], [[Conserver]], [[Corrupted Conserver (Nil Zone)|Corrupted Conserver]], [[Nuclear Monster]], [[Kronus]], [[Null Commander]], [[Frost Spirit]], [[Producer]], [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]], [[Titus]], [[Corrupted Titus]], [[Null Guardian]], [[Brute]], [[Patient Zero]], [[Corrupted Haz3mn]], [[Fallen King]], [[Wox the Fox]], [[Nerd Ducky]], [[Ducky D00M III]], [[Molten Warlord]], [[Executioner (Pizza Party)|Executioner]], [[Jack-o-Bot]], [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] and [[Gunslinger]]. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. **[[Stun Immunity]] added. {{ZombieNavBox}}
